name: Coleco Telstar
significance: Pioneered low-cost consumer gaming hardware through third-party off-the-shelf LSI silicon, selling over one million units.

editorialContent.overview: The first mass-market console utilizing General Instrument's single-chip architecture, spawning an affordable multi-game line.
